text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing fatigue, lower leg swelling, and weight loss. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in your urine output, such as foaminess or a decrease in volume?

speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure.

Given the age, significant weight loss, bilateral leg swelling, and history of chronic bronchitis, these symptoms strongly suggest heart failure rather than kidney or liver disease. To confirm this, I need to see the results of your Echocardiogram.
